messages.content: @yassine @Torq_boi FYI the TCP models are a huge improvement on the jerkiness of the path specially at low speeds for HKG Angle Steering. I don't need to damp the requests at low speeds anymore as it no longer shakes.
nice, you tried this morning's model yet?
I will pull it on device and have it tested tomorrow
Tested TCPv3 for a short amount and it was very good, very stable. Great for my hkg angle steering

Tried TCPv2 on a RHD motorway for over a hundred km today and it was hugging left for me like Nevada and not good.
Then tried gWM8 for a couple hundred km which was fine (almost no hugging, like stock release Space Lab 2).
Also tried Steam Powered 2 which was fine but was a little looser moving around the lane. 

The model switcher is really cool in Sunnypilot, nice work!
